name: ReadyAI
notes: min_compute.yml declares miner gpu required True, min_vram 8 (rec 24). A separate 'miner-cpu' profile at min_compute.yml:59 sets gpu required False, so a CPU-only miner path exists. Docker compose + Dockerfile plus pip/venv start scripts; .env config.

name: BitMind
notes: min_compute.yml only specifies a validator block: gpu required True, min_vram 80 (A100 80GB). No miner compute_spec block; header comment (min_compute.yml:1-4) says miner needs vary by model and a GPU is likely for training. Docker + install.sh + uv lockfile.

name: OxMarkets
notes: Validator-only repo (cartha_validator package); recursive grep for gpu/cuda/nvidia/vram across md/yml/toml/txt/Dockerfile returned zero hits, so no GPU evidence either way. Run via 'uv run python -m cartha_validator.main', supervised by PM2. No miner code present in clone.

name: ChronoLLM
notes: Only validator deploy path is in-clone: pinned image digest with deploy.resources.reservations.devices driver nvidia, count 1, capabilities [gpu]. pyproject.toml:8 requires torch>=2.0. Runs inside a dstack/Phala TEE (mounts /var/run/dstack.sock), needs OPENAI_API_KEY + HF_TOKEN. README:92 caps models at 2B params. No VRAM figure stated anywhere.

name: Ralph
notes: Dockerfile:30 FROM nvidia/cuda:12.4.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 and Dockerfile:50 pip install torch --index-url .../whl/cu124; docs/validator_setup.md:15 states a GPU (H100/H200) is needed for hidden-eval. docs/whitepaper_v1.2_updates.md:74 requires a confidential-computing-capable H100/H200/B200 under Intel TDX or AMD SEV-SNP for every scored miner run, so consumer GPUs are excluded (whitepaper_v1.2_updates.md:104). 80 GB VRAM appears only as the hardware of a calibration run (docs/recipe/s3_wall_clock_calibration.md:13), not as a stated minimum, so vram left unknown. README:109 offers a CPU-only smoke test but that is not a mining path. REWORKED: prune_rank null -> 'unknown' (upstream dereg.prune_rank is null because the subnet is inside its immunity window: dereg.is_immune true, risk_level 'immune', immunity ends 2026-10-13).

name: Almanac
notes: README.md:87 'No GPU is required - LLM inference is remote via the central gateway'; hardware table README.md:97 lists GPU None/None, 4-8 vCPU, 8-32 GB RAM, 50-100 GB SSD. Docker Engine + Compose plugin, amd64 Linux required, PM2 supervision. Needs WANDB_API_KEY and outbound access to api.almnc.ai.

name: Graphite
notes: min_compute.yml:21 miner gpu required False (validator also False at :48); 4 cores / 8 GB RAM / 10 GB disk. Plain pip requirements.txt + neurons/, run.sh wraps PM2 with auto-update. Clone is stale: last commit 2025-10-12, ~10 months old.

name: Score
notes: Example miner deploys to Chutes with NodeSelector gpu_count 1 and min_vram_gb_per_gpu 16 (excludes 5090/b200/h200/h20/mi300x); scorevision/miner/open_source/MINER.md:8 requires GPU/cloud capacity for inference. pyproject.toml:50 pulls torch/torchvision/torchaudio. GPU is rented via Chutes rather than run locally. Docker + compose + uv lock; separate VALIDATOR.md path.

name: AlphaRidge.ai
notes: min_compute.yml:24 miner gpu required True, min_vram 8 (rec 24, A100 suggested); validator same at :59. README.md:213 installs torch from the cu128 wheel index, confirming CUDA. Python 3.12 venv + pip, plus a git-install of amazon-science/ReFinED; run_miner.sh / run_validator.sh, PM2 auto-updater optional.

name: Quantum Compute
notes: GPU is irrelevant here: min_compute.yml:25 sets validator gpu required False, and the miner block (min_compute.yml:16) declares only 'qpu: qpu'. README states miners must own/operate a physical gate-based quantum computer (OpenQASM 2.0/3.0) or hold a documented partnership with an operator, and onboarding goes through support@openquantum.com. Effectively not minable without QPU access despite trivial 0.0005 TAO registration. Plain pip requirements.txt + neurons/.
